node.closure: exact unordered-pair resolvent normalization plus challenge-field pole descent
node.statement: The rigid passport S6:5.1,2.1.1.1.1,6 has an explicit rational degree-15 normal form obtained as the unordered-pair quotient of the pinned BelyiDB degree-six companion. Its fibers are (6,6,3), (5,5,5), and (2,2,2,2,1,1,1,1,1,1,1). Its order-five fiber consists of -77 and 22 plus or minus 33 sqrt(5), so the required three-point pole divisor splits over F_(2130706433^6). No split active fiber, quartic source-star incidence, m4 deletion, owner charge, endpoint, or row close is claimed.
